mapper.sql:
SELECT '02' AS issueStage, SEC_INFO.SEC_ID finprodMarketId, SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION finprodAbbr, null as finprodId, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_METHOD ,RELEASE_INFO.ISSUING_METHOD) as issueClass, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE * 10000 , ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE / 10000, 2)) as planIssueAmt, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE) AS issueDate, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE, RELEASE_INFO.PAYMENT_DEADLINE) AS payEdate, SEC_INFO.VARIETY_OF_COUPONS couponSpecies, SEC_INFO.RATE_TYPE intType, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX) as issuePrice, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO_CP.COUPON_RATE, RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE) as referYield, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE) AS firstConfirmDate, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MIN_SUB_AMT * 10000, ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT / 10000, 2)) as minPamt, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT * 10000, ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.SINGLE_MAX_SUB_AMT / 10000, 2)) as maxPamt, SEC_INFO.TRADING_PLACES tradeMarket, SEC_INFO.ISSUER as issuer, SEC_INFO.CURRENCY ccy, SEC_INFO.PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION type9, SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION type10, null as type11, ZT.RATING as subRate, MCI.CUSTOMER_NAME as subRateOrg, ZX.RATING as debRate, MCIT.CUSTOMER_NAME as debRateOrg, RDI_RELEASE_INFO.REMARK as remark, RELEASE_INFO.BIDDING_METHOD as tenderType, RELEASE_INFO.RELEASE_TYPE as issueStyle, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS issueDateStr, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR( RELEASE_INFO.PAYMENT_DEADLINE,'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS payEdateStr, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS firstConfirmDateStr
FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO SEC_INFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO RELEASE_INFO ON SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = RELEASE_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO RDI_RELEASE_INFO ON RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SECURITY_ID = SEC_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO where SECURITY_TYPE in('CD','14')) RDI_RELEASE_INFO_CP ON RDI_RELEASE_INFO_CP.SECURITY_ID = SEC_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC) RANK,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING,BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '01' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 ) ZT on PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = ZT.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI ON MCI.CUSTOMER_ID=ZT.GRADE_ORG_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSET_CODE,RATING,GRADE_ORG_ID FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BRATING.O_CODE ORDER BY BRATING.O_CODE,BRATING.GRADE_DATE DESC ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT DESC ) RANK ,BRATING.O_CODE AS ASSET_CODE ,BRATING.GRADE_RESULT AS RATING,BRATING.GRADE_ORG_ID as GRADE_ORG_ID FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING BRATING WHERE BRATING.O_TYPE = '02' AND BRATING.GRADE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RANK=1 ) ZX ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = ZX.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCIT ON MCIT.CUSTOMER_ID=ZX.GRADE_ORG_ID
